map.录入武术套路的标准完成时长与个人实际耗时，对比评估套路完成速度与节奏控制能力，用: Enter the standard completion time of a martial arts routine and your own actual time to compare and assess your speed and rhythm control, for tracking training progress.
map.武术/套路比赛演练：不同拳种规定完成时间（长拳70-90s、南拳65-85s、太: Martial arts and routine competition: each style has a prescribed completion time (Changquan 70-90 s, Nanquan 65-85 s, Tai Chi 300-420 s, Tai Chi sword 180-240 s, saber/spear/staff/single stick 70-90 s). The timing stops as soon as the routine ends; the tool compares against the standard time and estimates the deduction.
map.日常训练自测：用计时器记录单遍套路耗时，对比自身历史与标准范围，判断节奏是否偏快: Daily training self-check: use the timer to record one pass of a routine, compare it with your own history and the standard range, judge whether the rhythm is too fast or too slow, and correct the pace.
map.裁判/教练复核：现场输入实测耗时与该项目标准，立即得偏差与是否在允许范围，支持赛: Judge or coach review: enter the measured time on site together with the standard for the event to get the deviation and whether it is within the allowed range, which supports pre-event rhythm calibration.
map.算例：长拳标准比对: Worked example: Changquan against the standard
map.：长拳标准时长范围 70-90s，标准取值=(70+90)/2=80s，容差2s:
The Changquan standard range is 70-90 s, the standard value = (70+90)/2 = 80 s and the tolerance is 2 s.
Measured 85 s: deviation = 85-80 = +5 s, and 70≤85≤90 is within the allowed range → status "good"; since it does not exceed the bounds the estimated deduction is 0.
Measured 95 s: deviation = +15 s and 95>90 exceeds the upper limit → status "too slow", deduction = (95-90)×0.5 = 2.5 points (0.5 points per second over).
Note: Tai Chi is not bound by the lower-limit penalty (a too-slow lower bound is not punished), while other styles deduct on the same rule below the lower bound.

map.标准时长是怎么定的？: How is the standard duration set?
map.各拳种竞赛规则规定演练时间区间（如长拳 70-90s、太极拳 300-420s）: Competition rules for each style define the performance time range (for example Changquan 70-90 s, Tai Chi 300-420 s). The standard value takes the midpoint of the range; within tolerance it is rated excellent, inside the range it is rated good, and outside the range the deduction is estimated at 0.5 points per second over.
map.为什么太极拳不扣下限？: Why is there no lower-bound penalty for tai chi?
map.太极拳讲究缓慢匀称，规则对「过快」通常不做下限扣分（下限偏快反而影响韵味），只对: Tai Chi emphasises slow, even movement, and the rules usually apply no lower-bound penalty for being too fast (a too-fast lower bound actually spoils the style) and only deduct for exceeding the upper limit; other fast styles are bound on both sides.
